title: A total noob looking for guidance
author: Adventurous_Bit_2408
selftext:
Hi. I vibecoded a pokemon fan version of stadium (2d tho) in gemini with the only added function of being able to use all moves instead of just 4, using a variation of conditional turn based battling system, instead of the standard one. 

It's still only halfway, but unfortunately I don't have the gall to post anything about it in any pokemon community, but I wish to get some criticism as a designer. And on how to pitch this, or anything like, when I feel confident enough, if I do. 

Thank you in advance.

[CTB Stadium](https://neerajneonemesis.github.io/CTB-Stadium/)

It's a browser game btw.

But also, won't swapping out the pokemon make it stop being a game where a pokemon can use all It's moves😅

comments.author: Kingnorik
comments.body: Very interesting idea. I think right now you need to slow down cpu moves. It's hard to see what they are doing.

replies.author: Adventurous_Bit_2408
replies.body:
The av system is only there to determine turn order, and it's a fast-paced game otherwise.
Plus, the game expects the player to anticipate ai moves based on the energy consumed and the action value generated, which itself might look big, but the best choice for every situation for every mon are almost always 2-3 moves dependent to where the gamestate is at. 
But still, i added a log system to keep track of the battle as it takes place. Are u suggesting that it won't be enough? Please expand the concern. Becuz, this is something I might miss, since I know every move of every mon.

replies.author: Kingnorik
replies.body: I meant like the info of what move was just used, the animation, everything about the attack. It's very hard to follow.

replies.author: Adventurous_Bit_2408
replies.body:
From the screen itself, I felt the same as well. But I didn't feel good on breaking the pace at the same time. I did end up implementing the text, but I moved it to logs, added sfx split for physical and special moves, heals, buffs and whatnot, turn order preview (when you click on a move, the turn order updates your action value to what it will be if you decide to do it), you know QOL stuff, and concluded myself that the issue has been resolved. I'm sorry but I'll look into ways of displaying this mid battle without checking the logs. It's something I did try and failed, so do you have any idea of implementing this without hurting the pace at all.
